message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the weather API response fields or user-supplied inputs before they are used in predictions.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code fetches data from the OpenWeatherMap API using a hardcoded API key with no checksum verification, certificate pinning, or integrity checks on the returned JSON payload.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code applies no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training or inference data before processing.
No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded directly from 'model.h5' with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before use.
No detected label distribution validation: The code only loads a pre-trained model and performs inference; there is no training loop or label distribution validation logic present.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No training loop exists in this code, and there is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism of any kind.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial robustness testing framework or technique in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code performs no evaluation metrics computation, holds no isolated test set, and provides no signing, hashing, or any other mechanism to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The predict() function directly wraps raw inputs into a numpy array and feeds them to the model without any shape, range, type, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: The prediction result is returned and printed without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds applied to the model output.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a numerical time-series/regression model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
